subject: lg-dy
title: LG.DY.------MT.INFO.
description: Diagram in NYM-27. (C)LG-DY (logical dynamics) is crossed with MT-INFO (music information). The diagram poses what logical dynamics looks like when crossed with music information — a pairing that interrogates how western 'logic' processes a music whose primary information is non-logical. MT-INFO → LG-DY (the crossing); AFL (affinity alignment) → LG-DY; PR-INT (primary intention) → LG-DY. A parallel chain: C-CONT (composite continuance) → PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics), which branches to EXT-DYM (extended dynamics) and PRI-AF-TO (primary affinity tendencies) → P-FC (particular focus) → AFTD (affinity tendencies). PR-INT also → PART (participation) → PHY-U-P (physical universe particular). Structural argument: logical dynamics, when crossed with music information, is over-determined upstream — fed by music information itself, by affinity alignment, *and* by primary intention. But notice: there is no edge from logical dynamics *outward* in the diagram. Logical dynamics is a terminal node — it absorbs three upstreams and produces no outputs. The parallel composite-continuance → projectional-dynamics chain runs entirely separately, fanning into extended dynamics and primary affinity tendencies → particular focus → affinity tendencies. Primary intention also forks into participation → physical universe particular. The diagram thus stages Braxton's diagnostic claim: when music information is filtered through western logical dynamics, the *productive* outputs (extended dynamics, affinity tendencies, physical-universe-grounded participation) come not from logical dynamics but from the parallel composite-continuance and primary-intention chains. Logic absorbs the music; it does not transmit it.
